planets.name: K2-53 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-53 with a 12.2-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-53 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-53. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
